sources_overall.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies on this list.
Work the Roadmap view top to bottom: story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup.
This platinum unlocks automatically the moment your 54th other trophy pops.
trophies.guide: The platinum is automatic: it pops when the other 54 trophies are all earned, exactly as its official description ('You're a Leonida Legend') implies for a completion reward. PowerPyx rates the full set 4/10 difficulty at roughly 200 hours with a single playthrough enough, so plan for length rather than difficulty and follow the roadmap stages in this app.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start a new game and play the opening.
Finish the mission named Gone Fishing.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the opening mission: the official description says only 'Complete Gone Fishing', so simply play the prologue through to its end and this unlocks with no choices or side conditions attached. It cannot be skipped because the story is linear here.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play every Chapter 1 story mission in order.
Before finishing the chapter, do the Chapter 1 meditation at home (see Positive Mental Attitude).
The trophy pops when Chapter 1 closes.
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Chapter 1, per the official description. While you are in this chapter, take the home meditation opportunity as soon as it is offered: PowerPyx flags that first meditation spot as the one missable step in the whole list, and it belongs to this chapter, so clear it before the chapter ends.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play every Chapter 2 story mission in order.
Keep a manual save at the chapter start.
The trophy pops when Chapter 2 closes.
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Chapter 2, per the official description (the name is printed exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included). PowerPyx notes there is free roam after the story but no mission replay, so keep a manual save at each chapter start as insurance even though this chapter trophy itself is unmissable on a normal playthrough.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play every Chapter 3 story mission in order.
Keep scanning new vehicles and studying animals as you travel.
The trophy pops when Chapter 3 closes.
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Chapter 3, per the official description. PowerPyx's roadmap Step 1 advises scanning vehicles and studying animals as you go during the story rather than grinding them later, and this mid-game chapter is a good point to build that habit.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play every Chapter 4 story mission in order.
Keep a manual save before the chapter's final missions.
The trophy pops when Chapter 4 closes.
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Chapter 4, per the official description. With only one chapter left after this, it is also the right moment to check this tracker for any activity or collectible you can finish before the finale, because cleanup is easier while every system is already unlocked.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Finish Chapter 5 and reach the final mission.
Save manually before starting it.
Complete the final mission; the gold trophy pops at the end.
trophies.guide: The gold story trophy: the official description ties it to completing the final mission. PowerPyx confirms free roam continues after the credits and everything for the 100% checklist stays accessible, so finishing the story locks nothing away — the only exception in the game is the Chapter 1 meditation covered under Positive Mental Attitude.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
steps: Reach the story mission Breakfast Run.
Play it through to completion.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the named mission Breakfast Run, per the official description. Play the main story in order and it unlocks as part of normal progression; no optional objectives are attached to it.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Reach the story mission The Cartel Heist.
Play it through to completion.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the named mission The Cartel Heist, per the official description. It is earned by finishing that story heist on the main path; later free-roam bank robberies belong to Maximum Withdrawal instead, so do not confuse the two.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Reach the story mission Child's Play.
Play it through to completion.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the named mission Child's Play, per the official description. Progress the main story and it unlocks automatically when that mission ends.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Reach the story mission Headliners.
Play it through to completion.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the named mission Headliners, per the official description. It unlocks on the main story path with no side requirements.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Reach the story mission VCIA Takedown.
Play it through to completion.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the named mission VCIA Takedown, per the official description. VCIA is the airport; note that the separate free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can also involves VCIA but is a different, optional stunt — this one is purely the story mission.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Reach the story mission Operation Savage Glory.
Play it through to completion.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the named mission Operation Savage Glory, per the official description. Progress the main story and it unlocks when that mission ends.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story so the 100% checklist appears under Progress > Stats.
Work the checklist: story tasks, robberies, activities, collectibles and scanning.
Only 70 of 80 challenges are needed, so skip the hardest few.
The gold pops when the checklist reaches 100%.
trophies.guide: The long gold: the official description demands 100% completion, and PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy while stressing the checklist is lenient — roughly 60% of true completion, needing for example 200 of 277 vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied rather than everything, and only 70 of the 80 challenges. PowerPyx's roadmap puts this in Step 2, after the story, at roughly 100 hours; most of it fills in while you earn the other trophies.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Attempt stunt jumps and stunt events whenever you pass one.
Track the count toward 250 as you explore.
Finish any remaining stunts in post-story free roam.
trophies.guide: The official description sets the target at 250 stunts. PowerPyx clarifies that there are 397 stunts in total across 4 categories, so you only need about two-thirds of them — pick the easy jump-based ones and leave awkward ones behind. Stunts also feed the 100% checklist, so progress here pays twice.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
steps: Open the map and note every distinct activity icon type.
Play each type once — a single attempt counts.
The trophy pops when the last untouched type is tried.
trophies.guide: The official description asks you to try each type of activity once — attempting counts, winning does not. Work through the map's activity icons one type at a time and use this tracker to note which types remain; it usually completes naturally while sampling content for other trophies.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
steps: Visit every Shooting Range location.
Learn each challenge's target pattern, then chase gold scores.
All 42 challenges at gold unlock the trophy.
trophies.guide: Gold medals in every Shooting Range challenge, per the official description. Launch-era lists put the challenge count at 42, and PowerPyx notes the shooting-range golds are not too difficult and that Shooting Ranges are one of the few 100%-checklist sections that must be done in full — so clear each range fully when you first visit it instead of returning later.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
steps: Find each Top Fun Drone Race location on the map.
Win one race at each location (any difficulty the game offers).
The trophy pops when the final location is won.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at every location, per the official description — one win per location is enough, not every race. PowerPyx counts 14 drone race locations with 42 races between them and lists Drone Races among the 100%-checklist sections that require everything, so winning once per location serves both this trophy and A Long Road.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Enter races across Leonida as they unlock.
Win 20 distinct races — repeats of the same race do not add to the count.
The trophy pops on the 20th different win.
trophies.guide: The official description requires wins in 20 different races, so variety matters more than repetition: move around the map instead of re-running one easy race. Race wins also sit inside the broader activities pool that feeds 100% completion.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
steps: Unlock fishing and find Cal's fishing challenge.
Enter the challenge and out-catch Cal within its rules.
Winning the challenge unlocks the trophy.
trophies.guide: Beat the named character Cal in his fishing challenge, per the official description. This is a one-off contest rather than a grind: learn the fishing controls on ordinary spots first, then take Cal on when the challenge appears so your first attempt counts.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in the world.
Play one arcade game through to completion.
Finishing the game unlocks the trophy.
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game, per the official description — a single full playthrough of any cabinet is enough. It is one of the quickest cleanup trophies, so it fits naturally in the roadmap's final cleanup stage.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
steps: Take Andy's missions whenever his strand appears.
Work through his whole mission chain.
His final mission's completion unlocks the trophy.
trophies.guide: Finish the named character Andy's mission strand: the official description ties the trophy to his final mission, so follow his chain from its first job to its last. Character strands like this one remain available around the story, and PowerPyx's roadmap Step 3 groups the character quests into post-story cleanup if you leave them late.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
steps: Take Kenton's missions whenever his strand appears.
Work through his whole mission chain.
His final mission's completion unlocks the trophy.
trophies.guide: Finish the named character Kenton's mission strand, per the official description: only the final mission of his chain triggers the trophy, so keep accepting his jobs until the chain ends. Leaving it to cleanup is safe — character quests are part of PowerPyx's Step 3.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
steps: Take Billy's missions whenever his strand appears.
Work through his whole mission chain.
His final mission's completion unlocks the trophy.
trophies.guide: Finish the named character Billy's mission strand, per the official description. As with the other character trophies, the trigger is the strand's final mission, so a half-finished chain earns nothing — see it through, during the story or in cleanup.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
steps: Accept stranger encounters across Leonida as they appear.
Finish 8 complete strands, not just 8 first meetings.
The silver pops when the 8th strand is completed.
trophies.guide: The official description asks for 8 completed stranger mission strands across Leonida — whole chains, not introductions. PowerPyx's roadmap Step 3 is built around finishing these strands after the 100% push (about 10 hours of cleanup), so track strands here and finish any you started during the story.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
steps: Take Randy's missions whenever his strand appears.
Work through his whole mission chain.
His final mission's completion unlocks the trophy.
trophies.guide: Finish the named character Randy's mission strand, per the official description. The trophy triggers on his final mission only, so keep his chain moving whenever his marker shows, or clear it in the cleanup stage.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
steps: Take Tyrone's missions whenever his strand appears.
Work through his whole mission chain.
His final mission's completion unlocks the trophy.
trophies.guide: Finish the named character Tyrone's mission strand, per the official description. Like the other named-character trophies it pays out only at the end of the full chain, so do not leave the strand half-done when you move regions.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
steps: In Chapter 1, meditate at home the first time the spot is offered — this one disappears.
After that, meditate at every spot you find across Leonida.
Use a manual save from Chapter 1 as insurance if you skipped it.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — the one trophy to plan around. The official description requires meditating at every spot across Leonida, and PowerPyx flags this as the list's only potentially missable trophy: the first meditation spot, offered at home during Chapter 1, becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter, and with no mission replay there is no later fix. Meditate at home in Chapter 1 before anything else, then sweep the remaining spots in free roam.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
steps: Take Bret's hunting quests when they appear.
Track and hunt the unique animal he asks for.
Delivering the hunt unlocks the trophy.
trophies.guide: Hunt one unique animal for the named character Bret, per the official description. PowerPyx lists Bret's quests among the 100%-checklist sections that must be completed in full, so his hunting chain is worth finishing completely rather than stopping at this single trophy.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Pick up every collectible card you come across.
Focus on finishing whole sets rather than scattering effort.
Completing the 3rd full set unlocks the silver.
trophies.guide: The official description requires 3 complete Collectible Card sets — full sets, not 3 loose cards. Prioritise closing out one set at a time so progress is visible, and use the checklist's collectibles filter to keep this grind separate from story play.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Use the WAiNK action whenever a new location offers it.
Keep a running count toward 100 distinct locations.
Sweep remaining locations in free roam after the story.
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations, per the official description — the count is locations, so repeating one spot does not help. Spread attempts across the whole map as you travel for other trophies; the silver rewards steady exploration rather than a single grind session.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Complete challenges as they unlock during play.
Reach 50 completed challenges for this trophy.
Push on toward 70 if you are also chasing 100% completion.
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges, per the official description. PowerPyx notes the 100% checklist needs 70 of the game's 80 challenges, which lets you skip the hardest ones — so treat 50 as a waypoint: bank the easy challenges first and leave the worst few unattempted entirely.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
steps: Play as the pair with your partner present.
Raise a 4-star Wanted Level together.
Break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear.
trophies.guide: The official description spells out the recipe: with your partner beside you, reach a 4-star Wanted Level and then lose it completely. Commit the crimes with both characters together, then escape out of sight and wait out the search — the trophy needs the full lose-the-heat sequence, not just reaching 4 stars.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
steps: Bring your partner and pick a cluster of 3 nearby shops.
Rob the first shop and keep the Wanted Level alive.
Rob shops two and three without ever fully losing the heat.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while never losing your Wanted Level, per the official description. The failure point is the gap between shops: choose shops close together, move fast, and if the stars start blinking down, draw attention again before they clear so the chain stays 'back-to-back'.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Get into or scan every new vehicle model you see.
Vary your routes so new models keep appearing.
The trophy pops at 100 discovered vehicles.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles, per the official description. PowerPyx's roadmap advises scanning vehicles throughout the story rather than grinding later, and the 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 vehicles scanned — so every new model you hop into now counts toward two goals at once.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
steps: Find a group of at least 5 enemies close together.
Save your Combat Focus until the group is in range.
Trigger it once and take down all 5 before it ends.
trophies.guide: The official description demands 5 takedowns inside a single Combat Focus activation, so setup is everything: gather or find a clustered group first, line up the shots, and only then trigger the ability. Attempt it during busy missions or gang operations where enemies naturally bunch up.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
steps: Head to VCIA, the airport.
Take an aircraft out without authorisation — an unscheduled departure.
The trophy pops once you are airborne and away.
trophies.guide: The official description is a riddle with a plain answer: at VCIA (the airport), make an 'unscheduled departure' — steal a plane and take off. Expect a Wanted Level, so pick a fast aircraft and a clear runway line, and do it in free roam rather than during the VCIA Takedown story mission.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Find a Rhino tank in the world.
Get inside and drive it.
Survive the heat it draws until the trophy pops.
trophies.guide: The cryptic official description ('Kinda hot in these Rhinos') points at the Rhino tank: get into one and use it. 'Hot' fits the attention a stolen tank draws, so attempt this somewhere open where you can keep moving rather than getting boxed in.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
steps: Find a jewelry store and watch its staff and sightlines.
Enter quietly and take the goods without raising detection.
Leave undetected to unlock the trophy.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store with zero detection, per the official description — the opposite approach to Retail Therapy. Go in without brandishing a weapon openly, move only when unwatched, and if detection starts, leave and reset rather than forcing it: a detected robbery does not count even if you escape.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Locate bank vault robberies as they unlock.
Rob a vault, then escape the response completely.
Repeat until 5 vaults are robbed with clean escapes.
trophies.guide: The official description needs both halves five times: rob 5 bank vaults AND escape after each. A robbery that ends in arrest or death does not advance the count, so plan the getaway before entering — a fast car staged outside and a route away from the vault matter more than speed inside.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
steps: Watch for an armored truck on the road.
Stop it and break into the cash compartment.
Take the money and escape the response.
trophies.guide: Rob one armored truck and escape, per the official description — a single successful truck robbery with a clean getaway earns it. Hit the truck somewhere you can open it quickly and lose the heat immediately after, rather than in dense traffic where you get pinned.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Travel every region of the Leonida map.
Fill in any grey areas left on your map.
Full map coverage unlocks the trophy.
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida, per the official description — full map coverage of the state. It completes naturally if you chase the location-based trophies (meditation spots, WAiNK locations, drone races) across the whole map; use any remaining dark patches on your map as the checklist for what is left.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
steps: Identify each gang's illegal operation on the map.
Rob one operation belonging to each gang.
The trophy pops when every gang has been hit once.
trophies.guide: The official description requires robbing an illegal operation of EACH gang — one per gang, not several of the same one. Track which gangs you have already hit in this app; the last gang's operation is the one that pays out the trophy.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
steps: Travel to Ocean Beach.
Find a spot serving cocktails with a view.
Order and enjoy the cocktail there.
trophies.guide: The official description is unusually specific, so follow it literally: go to Ocean Beach, find a cocktail spot with a view, and have the drink. PowerPyx lists this trophy among the ones whose exact trigger was not yet pinned down at launch, so if one bar does not pop it, try the beachfront spots until the leisure interaction registers.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom.
Get into one of its cars.
Drive straight out through the showroom glass.
trophies.guide: Per the official description: inside a vehicle showroom, take a car and smash your way OUT through the front in 'classic style' — driving through the glass rather than using a door or rear exit. PowerPyx lists this among the launch-era trophies not yet fully pinned down, so the showroom exit through the window is the literal reading to try first.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley named in the description.
Play a game of bowling there.
Complete your follow-through shot at that alley.
trophies.guide: The official description names the exact venue — the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — and the act, a bowling follow-through. Bowling anywhere else will not count: travel to that named alley and play there. Note the name is printed here exactly as PlayStation publishes it, curly apostrophe included in the trophy name.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Progress the partnership storyline of the two protagonists.
Watch for a joint public-facing event for the pair.
Complete that partnered activity to unlock it.
trophies.guide: A deliberately cryptic hidden trophy: the official description ('A partnership with mass appeal') is the only hint PlayStation gives, pointing at the two protagonists' partnership reaching a public milestone. Because no cited source pins its exact trigger, this guide claims no specific step beyond the description itself — progress the duo's shared story and activities together and it unlocks along that path; treat any site claiming a precise trigger with caution unless it cites one.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Play the story and make its presented choices.
Either branch counts — the description says 'for better or worse'.
The trophy unlocks when the choice sequence resolves.
trophies.guide: The official description ('Choices made (for better or worse)') signals a story-choice trophy where the choice itself, not a 'correct' answer, is the trigger — the parenthetical explicitly blesses either outcome. PowerPyx notes there is no mission replay, so make your choice and move on; do not reload hunting for a better branch for this trophy.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Attempt the relevant activity once and let it fail or end.
Try the same thing a second time.
Success on the retry unlocks the trophy.
trophies.guide: The official description ('Second time's the charm') describes a fail-then-retry trigger: something must go wrong once and be attempted again. PowerPyx lists this among the trophies not yet pinned down at launch, so this guide stays with the description's own logic — if an attempt at a repeatable activity fails, retry it rather than reloading, and the second attempt is the one that pays.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore off the beaten path, especially at night.
Investigate any strange sighting or event you trigger.
Witnessing the full event unlocks the trophy.
trophies.guide: A secret-event trophy by its official description alone ('What the hell just happened?') — the wording signals a strange, probably UFO-flavoured encounter the game wants you to stumble onto. PowerPyx lists it as not yet pinned down at launch, so no precise location is claimed here: explore remote spots, follow up odd sightings to their end, and the witnessed event is the trigger.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
steps: Line up a group of pedestrians or enemies in a row.
Drive past them at speed.
Strike the group with a melee drive-by so they go down like pins.
trophies.guide: The official description is a pun with instructions inside: 'bowl 'em over' — knock a group down with a melee attack delivered from a moving vehicle, a melee drive-by. Set it up where several targets stand in a line, keep your speed up, and swing as you pass so the whole row falls in one run.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
steps: Unlock laundering through your contacts.
Feed Marked Bills into the laundering route whenever you hold them.
The trophy pops at $250,000 laundered in total.
trophies.guide: A money total, per the official description: $250,000 earned by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. It is cumulative, so route every batch of marked bills through contacts as you earn them during robberies rather than saving them up, and the total arrives well before the 100% push ends.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Buy normally across all shop types as you play.
The spend total is cumulative across every shop.
The trophy pops at $100,000 spent in total.
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, per the official description — the key phrase is 'across all shops': the counter is your combined spending everywhere, not in one store. Normal play (vehicles, weapons, property upkeep) reaches it without deliberate grinding; if it lags, late-game purchases close the gap quickly.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Buy garage properties as your funds allow.
Check the property listings for any garage not yet owned.
Buying the final garage unlocks the trophy.
trophies.guide: Purchase ALL garage properties, per the official description — this is a checklist of property purchases, so partial ownership earns nothing. Save it for the money-rich late game, buy every listed garage in one sweep, and the final purchase triggers the trophy.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app when you acquire a vehicle.
Register the vehicle to the app.
Repeat until 10 vehicles are registered.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the named Scooter Bros app, per the official description. Register each new vehicle as you acquire it rather than in one session — ten registrations accumulate quickly once vehicle discovery (Whip It Good) is part of your routine.

sources.name: Official PlayStation trophy list via Exophase
